name: com.statutewire/psv
title: StatuteWire
description: US healthcare exclusion screening (OIG, SAM, state Medicaid) and state license checks. No PHI.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Lists every exclusion source and every state license source with its status today: live, not live, or information only. Needs no key, is free and returns no provider data. A source that is not listed as live is not checked, so the list shows what a screening result can and cannot cover.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns plans, monthly request quotas, prepaid credit packs and deposit floors, in cents and dollars. Needs no key, is free and returns no provider data.

tools.name: how_to_get_access
tools.description: Returns how to get a sandbox key (sample data) and a live key, the sign-up URLs, and what each key returns. Needs no key, is free and returns no provider data.

tools.name: screen_practitioner
tools.description: Screens one practitioner and returns state license status and board discipline flags (only for states that are live; sandbox keys get SAMPLE data for every state), identity check against CMS NPPES, and exclusion screening (OIG LEIE, SAM.gov and the state Medicaid lists that are live), with an evidence receipt. Takes NPI + first name + last name + state; names that differ from the record block the result; they are not returned with a warning. The output lists which sources returned CLEAR and which did not. NOT_CHECKED and COULD_NOT_CHECK mean the source was not checked; they are not a clear result. It also shows the OFAC SDN list result by exact name (information only: a possible match is for review and never changes an exclusion result; not on the list is not a clearance). Each call costs money: it counts as one lookup against the key's quota or prepaid balance (1 check), the same as GET /api/v1/sanctions. Not covered: states that are not live, licenses of staff without an NPI (use screen_roster), anything not on the official lists. A possible match is a finding for a person to confirm with the official source. Results are possible matches only, drawn from the public lists named in the report. StatuteWire does not verify identity and does not determine employment or credentialing eligibility. You alone must confirm each result with the official source and make every employment and compliance decision. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer sw_live_… or sw_test_…); without one it returns an error that points to how_to_get_access.

first_name.description: The practitioner's first name, as on their license.

last_name.description: The practitioner's last name, as on their license.

state.description: Two-letter state code, or eNLC for the nursing compact (sample data only).

license_number.description: Required for states verified live; the error detail shows the format.

profession.description: Clinical profession, to scope the board search.

fresh.description: true skips the 120-day cache and queries the source again.

tools.name: screen_roster
tools.description: Adds practitioners to the account's roster for monthly monitoring (up to 500 per call). It adds rows only and does not delete or overwrite existing ones. It does not return screening results: results arrive with the next monitoring run and are read with get_receipt (roster_id + period). Each entry needs NPI + first name + last name. Quota or prepaid debit is applied as POST /api/v1/rosters/bulk applies it (one unit per newly enrolled license; duplicates and failures are free; prepaid live keys also need the enterprise deposit floor). Sandbox keys enrol sample data only; nothing is screened for real. Not covered: instant results, people without an NPI. Results are possible matches only, drawn from the public lists named in the report. StatuteWire does not verify identity and does not determine employment or credentialing eligibility. You alone must confirm each result with the official source and make every employment and compliance decision. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer sw_live_… or sw_test_…); without one it returns an error that points to how_to_get_access.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Fetches a signed receipt as JSON: either a practitioner receipt by file name (the .json file name from a screening result, for a practitioner on your roster) or a monthly roster receipt (roster_id + period YYYY-MM, built from your latest complete run). Free (rate limited, not metered). A sandbox or non-production receipt is labelled as such or UNSIGNED and proves nothing; verify_receipt checks a receipt. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer sw_live_… or sw_test_…); without one it returns an error that points to how_to_get_access.

file.description: Practitioner receipt file name ending in .json.

roster_id.description: Roster id (from your account). Use with period.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Checks a StatuteWire receipt JSON (the whole file text or object): hash, canonical form, Ed25519 signature against StatuteWire's published key, and roster totals. Free, not metered. VALID means the file is exactly as StatuteWire signed it; it does not say whether the practitioner is clean. A receipt signed with the SAMPLE key is reported as SAMPLE, not as valid. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer sw_live_… or sw_test_…); without one it returns an error that points to how_to_get_access.

receipt.description: The receipt JSON file contents, as a string or an object.

tools.name: get_practitioner_history
tools.description: The append-only audit ledger of monitoring events for a practitioner on this account's roster (a practitioner screened or rostered by this key). Free (rate limited). Not covered: practitioners not on your roster (404). Entries made from sample data stay labelled as sample data. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer sw_live_… or sw_test_…); without one it returns an error that points to how_to_get_access.
